(Source: Bloomberg)

must-read.title: Iran Sanctions Could Put China Oil Trade in Focus

(Source: Bloomberg)

大国博弈.title: US-Iran War Risks Repeated Cycles of Fighting
大国博弈.summary: Shifting US objectives and neither side able to secure a decisive military victory make a lasting resolution difficult and Bloomberg Economics Defense Lead Becca Wasser says risks the the US-Iran conflict becoming a protracted war. Joining Joe Mathieu and Carol Massar on Bloomberg This Weekend, Wasser explains that repeated pauses could allow both sides to adapt and rearm, potentially expanding the conflict geographically and making direct US-Iran talks necessary for a durable settlement. (Source: Bloomberg)
大国博弈.title_cn: 美伊战争风险导致反复的战斗循环
大国博弈.summary_cn: 美国目标的转变以及双方都无法取得决定性的军事胜利，使得持久解决变得困难。彭博经济防御部负责人贝卡·瓦塞尔表示，这可能导致美伊冲突演变为一场旷日持久的战争。瓦塞尔在本周末的《彭博》节目中与乔·马蒂尤和卡罗尔·马萨尔一起出现，解释说，反复的停顿可能让双方有机会适应并重新武装，潜在地扩大冲突的地理范围，并使美伊直接谈判成为实现持久协议的必要条件。（来源：彭博）

大国博弈.title: Trump's ‘Golden Age’ Pitch Meets Affordability Frustration
大国博弈.summary: President Donald Trump is touting a “golden age” for the US economy, but Bloomberg News White House Correspondent Catherine Lucey is on Bloomberg This Weekend and says persistent concerns over gas, food and housing costs are complicating that message ahead of the midterms. 产业趋势.title: Drone Swarms Push AI Deeper Into Modern Warfare
产业趋势.summary: Bloomberg News Cyber Security & Tech Reporter Katrina Manson got a firsthand look at autonomous drone-swarm technology that allows multiple aircrafts to coordinate and strike targets even when communications or GPS are disrupted. Joining Bloomberg This Weekend, Mason explains to Carol Massar that the Pentagon is testing the technology as part of its Swarm Forge program, but experiments in which AI identified civilian vehicles as potential targets highlight the risks as militaries push toward greater autonomy in warfare. (Source: Bloomberg)
产业趋势.title_cn: 无人机群将人工智能更深入地推向现代战争
产业趋势.summary_cn: Bloomberg News 网络安全与科技记者 Katrina Manson 亲眼目睹了自主无人机集群技术——该技术能够让多架飞机在通讯或 GPS 被干扰的情况下协同作战并对目标发动攻击。 在本周末的《Bloomberg This Weekend》节目中，Mason 向 Carol Massar 解释，五角大楼正将该技术作为其“Swarm Forge”计划的一部分进行测试，但人工智能在实验中把民用车辆误识别为潜在目标，凸显了军事在推动战争更大自主权时面临的风险。（来源：Bloomberg）
产业趋势.ai_summary: Bloomberg News网络安全与科技记者卡特里娜·曼森亲自体验了自主无人机群技术，该技术能够在通讯或GPS被干扰的情况下，让多架无人机协同并对目标进行打击。 在《彭博周末》节目中，曼森向卡罗尔·马萨尔解释，五角大楼正将其作为“蜂群锻造”（Swarm Forge）计划的一部分进行测试，但在人工智能将平民车辆识别为潜在目标的实验中，凸显了军事力量在推动战争更大自主性方面的风险。（来源：Bloomberg）

投资参考.title: Inflation Is Cooling. But is 2% Out of Reach?
投资参考.summary: BlackRock’s Rick Rieder says the latest CPI report gave markets reason to celebrate, but inflation remains above the Fed’s 2% target. He argues the economy is now “in the ballpark” and that raising overnight rates may not be the most effective way to bring inflation lower. The bigger issue for markets may be the long end of the yield curve, where fiscal deficits, heavy treasury issuance and AI-related financing push real rates higher. (Source: Bloomberg)
投资参考.title_cn: 通胀正在降温。但2%是否遥不可及？
投资参考.summary_cn: BlackRock的Rick Rieder表示，最新的CPI报告让市场有了庆祝的理由，但通胀仍高于美联储2%的目标。他认为经济现在"接近目标"，而提高隔夜利率可能不是降低通胀最有效的方式。对市场而言，更大的问题可能在收益率曲线的长期端，财政赤字、大量国债发行以及人工智能相关融资都在推动实际利率上升。（来源：彭博社）
